矿车是沿轨道行驶、
用来运输土石的车辆。 A mine cart is a wheeled vehicle that moves upon a rail and is used to transport sediment.

English: If you choose "Leave," you'll be whisked outside right away.
Japanese: 「脱出」を選んでもらえれば、すぐにお外までお連れします。
Target:
选择“脱出”，就能立刻送你到外面。
If you choose "Leave," you'll be whisked outside right away.

English: Time is money, as they say.
Target:
一寸光阴一寸金嘛。
Time is money, as they say.

Japanese: 本当に、よく喋るひとですね……
Target:
这人可真能说……
This guy sure can talk...

English: Choose "Get Me Out Now" if you're in a hurry.
Japanese: 急ぐなら「脱出」を選んでくださいね。
Target:
赶时间的话，就选“脱出”吧。
Choose "Get Me Out Now" if you're in a hurry.

English: Perhaps a wall could be broken.
Japanese: 何処かの壁が、壊せるかもしれませんよ？
Target:
说不定有哪面墙能打破？
Perhaps a wall could be broken.

Japanese: ショートカットしましょう。
Target:
抄个近道吧。
Let's take a shortcut.

English: What do you think they'll show at the...uh...show?
Japanese: ショーを見に行きましょう？……しょー……
Target:
去看场秀吧？……秀……
What do you think they'll show at the...uh...show?

English: Poor Pulche. His strength is at its limit.
Target:
普尔凯的体力已经到极限了……
Poor Pulche. His strength is at its limit.

……还是别往那边走了。
...Maybe don't go that way.

English: Maybe go and check on things.
Japanese: 様子を見に行ってみましょう……
Target:
去看看情况吧……
Maybe go and check on things.

English: Slay this beast! For the children!
Japanese: 子供達のためにも、打ち倒しましょう！
Target:
为了孩子们，打倒它！
Slay this beast! For the children!

English: Sometimes, a different perspective can be illuminating.
Target:
偶尔换个角度看看，或许会有发现。
Sometimes, a different perspective can be illuminating.

English: I swear I've seen something like this before...
Japanese: この模様、どこかで見覚えが……
Target:
这个图案……我好像在哪见过。
I swear I've seen something like this before...

English: The Frost Primal is mighty, but if you work together...!
Japanese: 強力な相手ですが、仲間と力を合わせれば……！
Target:
冰之神兽虽强，但只要大家齐心……！
The Frost Primal is mighty, but if you work together...!

English: You have a history with this one, but don't lose your cool.
Japanese: 因縁の相手ですが、冷静に……
Target:
虽是宿敌，也别乱了阵脚。
You have a history with this one, but don't lose your cool.

English: Well, unfortunately, the conflict between monsters and humans will continue.
Japanese: 人間と魔物の対立は、残念ながらこれからも続くでしょう。
Target:
遗憾的是，人类与魔物的冲突今后还会继续。
Well, unfortunately, the conflict between monsters and humans will continue.

English: But maybe one day, the friendship these four share will be the norm...
Japanese: けれど、いつかこの四人のように……
Target:
但愿有一天，人与魔物都能像这四人一样……
But maybe one day, the friendship these four share will be the norm...

Japanese: 貴方達の勝利を信じます。
Target:
我相信，你们终会取胜。
Someday, you'll be victorious.

English: Okay. It seems like there was a massive earthquake somewhere.
Japanese: どこかで、大きな地殻変動があったようです。
Target:
看来某处发生了剧烈地壳变动。
Okay. It seems like there was a massive earthquake somewhere.

English: What if you went back home?
Japanese: 村を見に行ってみてはどうでしょう……？
Target:
要不要回村看看？
What if you went back home?

Japanese: 奥に進んでみましょう……
Target:
继续往深处走吧……
Let's press on...

English: A fearsome foe indeed, but you've fought your share of those!
Japanese: 強敵ですが、ここまできた貴方なら……！
Target:
是强敌，但一路走到这里的你，定能应付……！
A fearsome foe indeed, but you've fought your share of those!

English: I think it'll be all right to stop the story for a little while and prepare.
Japanese: 物語を止めて、準備を整えるのもアリかなと思います。
Target:
暂且停下故事，整顿一番也无妨。
I think it'll be all right to stop the story for a little while and prepare.

English: So, once you're ready, it's on to the decisive battle.
Japanese: 準備が整ったら、決戦に臨みましょう。
Target:
准备妥当，就去决战吧。
So, once you're ready, it's on to the decisive battle.

English: You can't cross quicksand on foot. It's too dangerous.
Japanese: 流砂は、徒歩では渡れません。危ないですよ？
Target:
流沙不能徒步穿越，太危险了。
You can't cross quicksand on foot. It's too dangerous.

English: You won't survive if the quicksand pulls you under, you know.
Japanese: 流砂に飲まれたら、無事ではいられません。
Target:
被流沙吞没，可没法安然无恙。
You won't survive if the quicksand pulls you under, you know.

English: If only there were some way for you to just, like...glide across the sand.
Japanese: 「あれ」があれば、渡れるようになるんですけど……
Target:
要是有“那个”，或许就能滑过沙地了……
If only there were some way for you to just, like...glide across the sand.

English: I wouldn't want you to get burned!
Japanese: 火傷ではすみませんよ？
Target:
这可不只是烫伤那么简单！
I wouldn't want you to get burned!

English: Careful! You'll get burnt to a crisp.
Japanese: 黒焦げになっちゃいますよ？
Target:
小心，真会烧成焦炭的！
Careful! You'll get burnt to a crisp.

English: Look, it's not my fault if you roast yourself.
Japanese: 消し炭になっても知りませんからね。
Target:
真把自己烤焦了，我可不负责。
Look, it's not my fault if you roast yourself.

English: The fire's out, but it's not exactly safe to swim...
Japanese: 火は消えましたが、泳ぐのは危険です。
Target:
火虽然灭了，下水游过去还是危险。
The fire's out, but it's not exactly safe to swim...

English: Scaling this sheer, icy cliff is a tall order.
Japanese: この崖を登るのは難しそうです。
Target:
这片冰崖太陡，恐怕爬不上去。
Scaling this sheer, icy cliff is a tall order.

English: You can keep trying, but it won't get any easier.
Japanese: 何度挑戦しても、よじ登れませんよ？
Target:
再试多少次也爬不上去哦？
You can keep trying, but it won't get any easier.

English: You WILL get frostbite. Listen, sometimes it's okay to give up.
Japanese: 手が霜焼けになっちゃいますよ？時には諦めも肝心です。
Target:
手都要冻伤了。有时放弃也不失为明智之举。
You WILL get frostbite. Listen, sometimes it's okay to give up.

English: Ahem, sorry... Throat's a bit dry...
Target:
……抱歉，嗓子有点干。
Ahem, sorry... Throat's a bit dry...

English: I can feel the chill from here.
Japanese: 見ているだけで、凍えそうです。
Target:
光看着都觉得冷。
I can feel the chill from here.

English: Are you asleep over there? Sweet dreams.
Japanese: 寝ちゃいました？……よい夢を。
Target:
睡着了吗？……做个好梦。
Are you asleep over there? Sweet dreams.

就这一次哦？
Just this once, okay?

English: All right. Best of luck building your fortune!
Japanese: では、がんばって稼ぎましょう。
Target:
那就努力赚个盆满钵满吧！
All right. Best of luck building your fortune!

运气也是实力的一部分。
Sometimes you get lucky.

English: Fear not. Though their card shows a coffin, they're not actually dead.
Japanese:
心配しないでください。棺桶カードになっても、
本当に死んだわけではありませんので。
Target:
别担心。卡牌虽然变成了棺材，
人可没真死。 Fear not. Though their card shows a coffin, they're not actually dead.

English: Unfortunately, it seems this is the end of your journey...
Japanese: 残念ですが、貴方の旅路はここまでのようです……
Target:
遗憾，你的旅途似乎到此为止了……
Unfortunately, it seems this is the end of your journey...

赢得漂亮。
A masterful victory.

果然没让我失望。
I expected nothing less.

Japanese: その調子で行きましょう。
Target:
就是这样！
That's how it's done!

Japanese: 敵が力を溜めています。
Target:
敌人正在蓄力……
That enemy's gathering power...

English: Get ready to defend against that attack...
Japanese: 強力な攻撃に備えましょう……
Target:
准备防住那一击……
Get ready to defend against that attack...

Japanese: 守りを固めてください。

English: That's a good way to break your weapon... Maybe try something else?
Japanese: 武器、壊れちゃいますよ……もうやめておきましょう？
Target:
再砍下去武器都要坏了……换个办法吧？
That's a good way to break your weapon... Maybe try something else?

English: You're surprised? He is a merchant, after all...
Target:
不愧是商人……
You're surprised? He is a merchant, after all...
